title: SaveProfileNotesRequest
description: Parameters for profile.saveNotes: everything about a repository that the user authored rather than a model. Kept on its own method, and in its own columns, because regeneration overwrites the generated document and must be structurally incapable of touching any of this. It can be saved before a profile has ever been generated.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root.

userNotes.description: The user's standing notes about this repository. Empty string to clear them.

customInstructions.description: Free text injected into every analysis prompt for this repository. Empty string to clear it.

customExcludedGlobs.description: Globs, on top of the built-in list, whose file contents the toolbox must withhold from the model. Matching files stay visible and are still listed; only their contents are refused.

characterBudget.description: Hard size budget for the generated document, in characters. Absent to restore the default. Raising it makes every future analysis of this repository more expensive, which is why it is set per repository rather than once for the application: a monorepo needs the room a small service does not.
